interpretation: All timestamps use monotonic_ns and exclude database opening/schema migration.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE execute duration includes SQLite lock wait plus Python/SQLite overhead; it is not an exact internal wait counter.
Successful BEGIN return establishes a held writer lock; the interval from that return to commit invocation is a directly observed definite-hold window.
For implicit reserve transactions, first-write return to context-exit invocation is the definite-hold window; BEGIN trace precedes lock acquisition.
Commit-call/context-exit durations include commit work and release; exact VFS lock acquisition/release instants are not instrumented.
No lock duration is inferred from total scan time; no scans or detectors run.
Connection instrumentation adds overhead; samples are finite synthetic measurements, not a portable performance guarantee.
method: Actual SQLiteScanStore with a runtime-only Connection subclass; control categories and monotonic boundaries only; no SQL or fixture content.
